description: Translate a resume into another language and save it as a separate document. The original stays. Uses AI credits. It also works without a resume-builder document. It uses the resume the user pasted or attached in this conversation (pass its text as resume_text), else the base resume uploaded to their account, else their resume-builder document. In ChatGPT the user can attach a resume file; pass it as resume_file.

resume_file.description: Only for a resume file the user attached in ChatGPT: pass the attached file here, not retyped text. In any other client pass resume_text or resume_url. It is downloaded once, right away: PDF, DOCX or plain text, up to 10 MB.

resume_text.description: The resume the user pasted or attached in this conversation, as plain text. Omit it to use the resume already on the user's GetMattered account.

name: getmattered_translate_resume

setupStep.description: Set while account setup is open: the step to take first.

source.description: pasted / attached: the resume shared in this chat; on_file: the uploaded base resume (ids are document ids); builder: a resume-builder document (ids are builder ids).

translatedContent.description: The translated resume text, when it is ready.

title: Translate Resume
